The '''Kokash system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kokash sector/Legends|Kokash sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was visited in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] by the colonization and exploration [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' on a shakedown cruise through the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kokash system was first introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-10.<ref name="TEA" />
